description: This file defines sound effect catalog and playback mechanisms for a macOS application. It includes enumeration of system sounds, methods to obtain sound URLs, and a player class for sound playback.

classes.name: SoundEffectPlayer
classes.description: A singleton-like utility enum for managing and playing NSSound objects, including variables for last played sound and methods to retrieve and play sounds from names or bookmarks.

methods.name: systemOptions
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all discoverable system sound names with 'Glass' pinned first.

methods.name: displayName(for:)
methods.description: Returns the display name for a given raw sound name, currently a passthrough.

methods.name: url(for:)
methods.description: Retrieves the URL associated with a sound name from the discovered sound map.

methods.name: sound(named:)
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve an NSSound by name, falling back to URL if not found.

methods.name: sound(from:)
methods.description: Creates an NSSound from bookmark data, managing security scope access.

methods.name: play(_:)
methods.description: Stops any current sound and plays the new NSSound object.
